CustomField.inlineHelpText: Audits that are more complex than a simple low volume statistical claim audit and could include appeal audits, clinical audits, DOL audits, financial audits, high volume statistical audits, security audits, etc. A standard or simple audit not included in this category would be a straightforward low volume (i.e. 220) statistical claim audit with minimal research or support required. A more complex audit would be higher volume, require extensive research, support and follow up.
CustomField.label: Complex External Audits
